parts.t: Queen Mary Park is a centrally located Surrey neighbourhood offering a mix of detached homes, townhouses and condominiums. With convenient access to King George Boulevard, SkyTrain connections and major commuter routes, Queen Mary Park remains popular with families, first-time buyers and investors.

Browse the latest Queen Mary Park MLS listings including affordable detached homes, newer townhomes and condo developments. Listings are updated regularly so you can view current prices, photos and full property details.
If you're considering buying or selling in Queen Mary Park, contact Jared Gibbons for local market expertise and strategic guidance.

Queen Mary Park is a hidden gem in Surrey's landscape, offering peaceful residential living centred around one of the city's most beautiful green spaces. This established neighbourhood attracts buyers seeking larger lots, mature trees, and proximity to the stunning Queen Mary Park Surrey with its gardens, walking trails, and serene natural setting.

Families appreciate the safe, quiet streets where children play and neighbours genuinely connect, plus excellent schools serving the area. The community features diverse housing from well-maintained character homes to renovated properties and occasional new builds on larger parcels. Residents enjoy easy access to shopping along King George Boulevard and Highway 99A, plus quick connections to Highway 1 and Highway 99 for regional travel. The park itself becomes an extension of residents' yards with picnic areas, sports facilities, and seasonal beauty that enhances daily life year-round. Ready to discover Queen Mary Park?
